data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small gross strengthening of prior-year (2021 and earlier) claims reserves of approximately 3.7 (reporting currency: USD million) based on the gross claims development table. The report narrative cites a $17.2m net increase in prior year reserves driven by increased loss estimates for Winter Storm Elliott and Hurricane Ida, partly offset by reductions for Hurricane Ian and the 2022 Australian floods and a strengthening on 2021 attritional reserves. The movements were primarily driven by natural catastrophe developments affecting property lines; the report's $17.2m figure is stated net of reinsurance and appears to include years beyond 2021, whereas the gross triangle-based calculation above is limited to 2021 and older.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary opening reserves come from the balance sheet (Claims outstanding, prior year column = 452.7 USDm) - high confidence. The report text states a $17.2m net increase in prior year reserves (net of reinsurance and apparently including 2022 movements). The JSON prior_year_development_gbp_m (3.7) was derived from the GROSS claims development table (gross triangle) by comparing the 2021 current estimate to its previous diagonal (triangle-based method) and therefore represents gross movement for 2021 and older only. There is no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line in the notes; the $17.2m figure in the narrative is net and includes multiple years, so both figures are reported (numeric value uses triangle per the extraction rules). Field names end with _gbp_m though amounts are presented in the report currency (USD) per instructions.
